title: Koke-koken da aka Ji Sama da Hayaniyar
intro: Kana jin murya tana tashi daga cikin al'umma inda zalunci ya zama ruwan dare. Babu wani nuna iko da zai amsa korafin; maimakon haka, kira kai tsaye ya isa ga Allah, kuma martanin ya isa zuciyar ibadar kanta. Wa ya yi wannan korafin, wace tambaya ce ta biyo baya, kuma wace gaskiya aka tabbatar?
clues: Na shiga damuwa da zaluncin da mutanen da ke kewaye da ni ke yi mini.
Na furta wannan korafin kai tsaye ga Allah a cikin korafin kaina.
Allah ya ji ƙarar kuma ya amsa da ƙalubale game da imanina.
Amsar ta yi tambaya ta yaya zan iya kasa yin imani da Allah, wanda Shi kaɗai ne kuma Maɗaukaki.
Sai na tambaye shi dalilin da yasa Allah zai fifita mutanen da suke kafirta.
Ni ne Uzair, an ambace ni a cikin Suratul Az-Zukhruf a matsayin wanda Allah ya ji ƙararsa.

trial.answer: Korafe-korafe ga Allah game da zaluncin da ake yi wa mutane

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Allah ya ji ƙarar kuma ya tabbatar da kaɗaitakar Allah da kuma Ubangijin da ya fi girma

Ketare babban ambaliyar ruwa lafiya a cikin jirgin

Karɓar mulki daga Gabas zuwa Yamma
outcome.answer: Allah ya ji ƙarar kuma ya tabbatar da kaɗaitakar Allah da kuma Ubangijin da ya fi girma

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
